descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• STARI Program Promotion: Brainstorm creative ideas, design promotional materials (e.g., posters, newsletters), and organize online/offline campaigns to drive employee engagement and cultivate a strong SHE culture.
• Occupational Health Assessments: Assist in conducting workplace Ergonomic (Ergo) risk assessments to identify improvements and enhance employee well-being.
• Health Event Support: Provide operational and hands-on support for the planning, logistics, and execution of the Annual Occupational Health Check-up event.
• Data & Case Management: Gather, sort, and analyze occupational health data to help identify trends; assist in employee health case documentation, follow-ups, and coordination with healthcare providers.
• Compliance & Safety Inspections ：Help monitor compliance with local regulations and Roche's internal SHE standards; participate in routine safety inspections to identify, document, and report hazards.
• Incident Response & Environment Initiatives: Participate in laboratory safety incident investigations (including work-related injuries), contributing to root cause analysis; support environmental sustainability initiatives such as waste management and pollution prevention.
• Documentation & Reporting: Assist in maintaining accurate and up-to-date SHE records, and help prepare routine compliance and performance reports.
• Other Tasks： Support other ad-hoc SHE administrative or operational tasks as assigned by the supervisor. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
